description: This file implements an in-memory configuration store for the Mattermost server, including methods for setting, loading, and managing configuration files and data.

classes.name: MemoryStore
classes.description: In-memory implementation of a configuration store, primarily for testing purposes.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Replaces the current configuration with a new one.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Serializes the stored configuration, applying environment overrides.

methods.name: GetFile
methods.description: Retrieves the contents of a stored configuration file.

methods.name: SetFile
methods.description: Stores or replaces a configuration file's contents.

methods.name: HasFile
methods.description: Checks if a file has been previously stored.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a description of the store type.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Performs cleanup, does nothing for memory store.
